PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.85, hemoglobin 11.7, platelets 267, sodium 140, wbc 8.1; vitals dbp 65-69, heart_rate 81-86, map 87-91, o2_flow 0-2, resp_rate 16-18, sbp 130-136, spo2 94-96, temp 36.8-37

Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Type 2 diabetes. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 57-year-old female, length of stay 2 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Type 2 diabetes. Follow up with primary care in one week.
